answer_1.quote: We explore UQ for long-text generation (at least 100 words), with an emphasis on using factuality as the key metric of the models' performance.

answer_2.quote: For each generated response, FACTSCORE calculates a factuality score (FS). We also compute lexical similarity using BERTScore and report Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients.

answer_4.quote: We also engaged human annotators to assess the factuality of the generated passages. We recruited three students with Master's degrees in Computer Science ... We used Fleiss' Kappa to measure inter-annotator agreement, achieving a score of 0.793.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to evaluate the factuality of each generated passage.
